preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The lower limit on the degree of the graph node k is between 2 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects nodes with indices between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a node to itself.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(neighbors)) >= k for node, neighbors in graph.items())
preconditions.description: Each node is connected to at least k other nodes.

postconditions.description: The length of the found cycle is at least k + 1 and at most n.

postconditions.expression: cycle[0] in graph[cycle[-1]] and all(cycle[i] in graph[cycle[i-1]] for i in range(1, len(cycle)))
postconditions.description: The cycle is a valid sequence of connected nodes.
